Request for Proposal (RFP)
DevOps Server License Module Implementation
Ministry of Education (MOE) – Roxy Data Center
1. Introduction
The Ministry of Education (MOE) invites qualified
vendors to submit proposals for the supply, implementation, and support of a DevOps
Server License Module to be deployed at the Roxy Data Center.
The objective of this RFP is to establish a fully
integrated DevOps platform that enables end-to-end software lifecycle
management, including development, automation, security, deployment, and
operational monitoring under a unified licensing model.
2. Background
MOE is undergoing a digital transformation initiative aimed
at modernizing software development, deployment, and operational processes
across its platforms and services.
To support this transformation, MOE requires a centralized
DevOps platform that:
Eliminates fragmented
tooling
Enhances collaboration
across development and operations teams
Integrates security
within the development lifecycle
Provides scalability to
support national-level systems
The solution will be hosted within the Roxy Data Center
and must align with enterprise-grade standards for performance, security, and
availability.
3. Scope of Work
The selected vendor shall:
Provide software
licensing for the DevOps Server platform
Design and implement the
solution within Roxy Data Center
Configure all required
DevOps, DevSecOps, and automation features
Integrate with existing
MOE systems (identity, infrastructure, monitoring)
Provide documentation,
knowledge transfer, and training
Deliver ongoing support
and maintenance services
4. Functional Requirements
4.1 Source Code Management (SCM)
The solution shall provide:
Distributed version
control repositories
Branching, merging, and
pull/merge request workflows
Role-based access
control for repositories
Web-based repository
management interface
Full audit trail of code
changes
4.2 CI/CD Pipeline Management
The solution shall support:
Declarative pipeline
definitions (e.g., YAML-based)
Automated build, test,
and deployment workflows
Event-based triggers
(code commits, schedules, API calls)
Parallel and scalable
pipeline execution
Artifact generation and
retention
4.3 Project and Work Management
The platform shall include:
Issue and ticket
management system
Agile boards (Scrum and
Kanban)
Sprint and milestone
tracking
Collaboration features
(comments, mentions, notifications)
4.4 Package and Artifact Repository
The solution shall provide:
Support for multiple
package formats (containers, binaries, libraries)
Version-controlled
artifact storage
Dependency caching and
proxy capabilities
4.5 User and Access Management
The platform shall support:
Role-Based Access
Control (RBAC)
Integration with
enterprise identity systems (LDAP / Active Directory)
Multi-project and
multi-team isolation
Comprehensive audit
logging
5. Advanced DevOps Requirements
5.1 DevSecOps Capabilities
The solution shall include:
Static code security
analysis
Dynamic application
security testing
Open-source dependency
vulnerability scanning
Secret detection
mechanisms
Container security
scanning
5.2 Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
The solution shall:
Support infrastructure
provisioning through code
Enable version control
of infrastructure definitions
Integrate IaC into CI/CD
pipelines
5.3 Deployment and Environment Management
The platform shall provide:
Multi-environment
lifecycle management (Dev, Test, UAT, Production)
Deployment strategies
including:
Blue/Green
Canary
Rolling deployments
Environment-specific
configuration control
5.4 Monitoring and Observability
The solution shall support:
Pipeline monitoring and
execution tracking
Integration with logging
and monitoring systems
Alerting and
notification mechanisms
Operational dashboards
5.5 API and Integration
The platform shall include:
Comprehensive REST APIs
Webhook support for
integrations
Compatibility with
third-party tools and cloud services
6. Enterprise Requirements
6.1 Governance and Compliance
The solution shall provide:
Policy enforcement for
pipelines and deployments
Approval workflows and
release gates
Compliance reporting and
audit trails
6.2 Analytics and Reporting
The platform shall include:
DevOps performance
metrics (e.g., deployment frequency, lead time)
Pipeline efficiency
analytics
Team productivity
insights
6.3 High Availability and Scalability
The solution shall:
Support clustered
deployment architecture
Enable horizontal
scaling of workloads
Provide load balancing
and failover mechanisms
6.4 Backup and Disaster Recovery
The platform shall include:
Automated backup
capabilities
Point-in-time recovery
Disaster recovery
options across sites
6.5 AI-Driven Capabilities (Optional)
Vendors are encouraged to provide:
AI-assisted code
analysis and recommendations
Predictive pipeline
failure detection
Intelligent automation
and optimization features
7. Deployment Requirements
The solution must be
deployed on-premises at Roxy Data Center
Support for private
cloud or hybrid architecture is preferred
Must align with MOE
infrastructure standards (compute, storage, network)
8. Security Requirements
The solution must:
Ensure encryption of
data in transit and at rest
Support Single Sign-On
(SSO), OAuth, and SAML
Provide fine-grained
access controls
Maintain detailed audit
logs for all activities
9. Operational Requirements
Web-based user interface
CLI and API access
Automated patching and
upgrade mechanisms
Role-based dashboards
and views
10. Licensing Requirements
Vendors must provide:
Flexible licensing model
based on:
Number of users
Compute/pipeline
capacity
Storage usage
Tiered licensing options
(Core / Advanced / Enterprise)
Clear definition of
included features per tier
11. Deliverables
The vendor shall deliver:
Fully deployed DevOps
platform at Roxy Data Center
Software licenses and
activation
Configuration and
integration with MOE systems
Technical documentation
Training sessions for
MOE teams
Support and maintenance
services

units.task_name: Extract Mandatory Technical Compliance Criteria & Model Multi‑Tier Labor Pricing
units.description: Parse the RFP content to identify all mandatory technical compliance items (e.g., security controls, data residency, audit requirements). For each criterion, map it to a labor pricing tier (e.g., Tier 1: core services, Tier 2: advanced services, Tier 3: specialized consulting) and calculate unit costs based on typical industry rates. Produce a structured table of criteria, associated pricing tiers, and cost estimates.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t1]
units.output_contract: A tabular dataset listing compliance criteria, assigned labor tier, hourly rate, estimated hours, and total cost per criterion.

units.task_name: Generate Executive Proposal with Compliance Traceability Matrix
units.description: Using the RFP text, extracted criteria, and pricing model, craft a polished executive proposal. Include an executive summary, solution overview, detailed compliance traceability matrix linking each RFP requirement to our proposed solution and cost, and a concise pricing breakdown. Format the output as a structured document (e.g., Markdown or JSON) suitable for submission.
units.input_contract: Requires verified outputs from upstream dependency nodes: [t2]
units.output_contract: A complete proposal document with compliance traceability matrix and pricing summary.

dag.goal: Create a comprehensive executive proposal for a government cloud migration RFP, including mandatory technical compliance criteria extraction, multi-tier labor pricing modeling, and a compliance traceability matrix.
dag.reasoning: The task requires three distinct phases: ingest or synthesize the RFP content, analyze it to extract compliance requirements and build a pricing model, then produce a polished proposal with traceability. Each phase is independent enough for parallel execution after its prerequisites are satisfied, and all operations are read‑only or internal data processing, so risk remains low.
